title: GET /v1/commerce/acme/budget, commerce key, read only: the first-issuance budget of the rolling window as the broker sees it now (the 70 percent alert of the monitor and the wave calendar read it). used = confirmed first issuances still inside the window plus the open reservations; reserved is the part of used that is not yet confirmed; quota is the class's own share of policy.budget.first_issuances_total; a class above its quota is borrowing. lapsed = how many of the used slots are held by a reservation that ended unconfirmed after a TXT was set (see acme-lapsed-response): the alert of the monitor on a systemic failure of the orders.
